newsitem.title: FRANCE: TF1 sees extra ad slot revenue 100 mln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: TF1 sees extra ad slot revenue 100 mln Ffr.

text.p: French Broadcaster TF1 expects the extra revenue from an extension of advertising time during films to be at the lower end of a scale of estimates ranging from 100 to 700 million francs a year, according to a TF1 executive.
TF1 advertising executive Corinne Bouygues said in an interview published on Monday that it was not possible to offer a precise estimate on the value of the ad time extension.
"But in principle it will be nearer the lower end of the range, 100 million francs," she said, addcontext would also have considerable imppact.
Politicians and newspapers have speculated that the recently awarded extension of advertising time could be worth anything between 100 and 700 million francs.
Bouygues's remarks appeared in the CB News Communication weekly.
